prompt:
Create a cinematic motion-previs board titled “SHADOW RUN.”

Show 8 connected widescreen frames from one continuous 15-second sequence, with small timestamps beneath each frame. Focus on readable poses, camera movement, speed, transformation continuity, and impact.

This is a storyboard for a sports-animation film, not a character sheet.

Main subject:

A simplified faceless freestyle skateboarder wearing a loose pale jacket, wide dark trousers, and riding a matte-black skateboard.

The skater should remain clearly human-shaped, but minimal and faceless. No realistic facial anatomy, no detailed identity, no logos, no extra characters, no scene text.

Important creature rule:

The shadow creature must always be a giant black panther.

It must never become a human, humanoid, monster-man, demon, ninja, warrior, or person-shaped figure.

The creature must keep clear panther anatomy in every frame where it appears: four legs, feline body, long tail, low predator posture, panther head, ears, paws, claws, and animal movement.

The panther is made from charcoal, graphite dust, smoke, and torn-paper fragments. It is not a black human silhouette.

Concept:

A freestyle skateboarder races through an endless warm-white void. The skateboard wheels leave rough charcoal tracks behind them. These tracks lift from the ground and transform into a giant black panther.

At first, the panther appears to chase the skater. By the end, it is revealed as the skater’s animal shadow, moving in perfect sync with the skateboarder.

Visual direction:

Use dry charcoal, graphite dust, torn-paper fragments, smoky ribbons, hand-drawn speed marks, paper texture, and rough brush motion.

Palette: warm white, black, and graphite grey. Add only one small crimson accent in the panther’s eye.

Style: experimental sports campaign, manga motion, charcoal animation, stop-motion detail, paper texture, and extreme wide-angle cinematography.

Timeline:

FRAME 1 — 0:00–0:01.8

Overhead 28mm shot. The skater enters diagonally at high speed and carves a sharp turn, cutting a bold charcoal arc across the white surface. The camera descends toward the skater.

Audio: wheel rumble, graphite scrape, restrained beat.

FRAME 2 — 0:01.8–0:03.6

Low side-tracking shot. The skater performs a high ollie as the charcoal trail tears from the ground like a black ribbon. The trail is still abstract and not yet a creature.

Audio: board pop, rushing air, beat locking in.

FRAME 3 — 0:03.6–0:05.4

Rear chase shot. The skater lands and accelerates. The floating charcoal trail splits into four animal limbs, like the early structure of a panther. The limbs strike the ground and throw graphite dust outward.

The shape should clearly suggest a four-legged feline forming, not a person.

Audio: heavy landing, claw scratches, rising bass.

FRAME 4 — 0:05.4–0:07.2

Fast circular camera orbit. The skater spins while the forming panther runs around them in the opposite direction. The creature has a clear animal body, long tail, low shoulders, and four running legs. Charcoal and torn-paper fragments spiral around them.

Audio: spinning board, layered scratches, building tension.

FRAME 5 — 0:07.2–0:09.0

Frontal tracking shot moving backward. The skater charges toward the lens while the fully formed giant black panther runs beside them. The panther is clearly an animal: four legs, feline head, tail, paws, claws, and predator stride. Their movements synchronize. The panther’s small crimson eye opens.

Audio: rapid wheel impacts, heavy footfalls, intensified beat.

FRAME 6 — 0:09.0–0:11.0

Under-board angle. The skater jumps over the camera as the board briefly breaks into graphite fragments. The panther passes under and around the skater like liquid animal-shaped shadow, still keeping its panther body, tail, head, and four legs.

Audio: beat drop, low pulse, slicing air, shadow sweep.

FRAME 7 — 0:11.0–0:13.0

Ultra-wide slow-motion shot. The skater lands in a low glide while the panther mirrors the motion beside them in a low feline run. Their silhouettes overlap as the panther folds into the skater’s ground shadow.

The panther should remain animal-shaped while merging. Do not turn it into a human shadow.

Audio: near silence, soft rumble, stretched graphite hiss.

FRAME 8 — 0:13.0–0:15.0

Extreme frontal shot. The skater drives toward the camera and performs one final explosive turn. The panther, still clearly a panther, merges completely into the skateboarder’s ground shadow, then erupts into massive charcoal strokes that flood the frame to black.

Audio: heavy bass hit, violent charcoal burst, abrupt cutoff.

Create a 15-second comedic short in a polished 2D-and-3D hybrid animation style, 16:9 widescreen. Modern supermarket self-checkout area, bright realistic environment, expressive character animation, deadpan visual humor, fast precise comedic timing, minimal dialogue.
The situation must be immediately understandable visually.

MAIN CHARACTER:
An ordinary adult man doing his grocery shopping. He is trying to finish quickly and go home. He becomes increasingly frustrated but tries to remain polite and composed.
0–3 seconds:
The man scans one box of cereal at a supermarket self-checkout.
BEEP.
He places the single cereal box into his shopping bag.
He looks at the checkout screen.
The screen clearly shows that TWO ITEMS have been scanned.
He looks at the one cereal box in his bag.
Then back at the screen.
He realizes the machine has scanned the same item twice.

3–6 seconds:
He taps the on-screen REMOVE ITEM button.
Nothing happens.
He taps it again.
Still nothing.
He looks at the screen, confused, then presses the button more firmly.
Still nothing.

6–10 seconds:
The machine displays:
PLEASE WAIT FOR ASSISTANCE.
The man looks toward the supermarket employee area.
Nobody is coming.
He presses the assistance button.
The machine repeats the same message.
He looks behind him.
A short line of customers has formed.
He tries to act casual while becoming visibly more nervous.
He presses the button again.

10–12 seconds:
A supermarket employee finally approaches.
The man immediately points at the screen and gestures toward the single cereal box, clearly explaining the problem without speaking.
The employee calmly taps one button.
The duplicate item disappears.
The man is amazed by how easy it was.
The employee walks away.

12–15 seconds:
Immediately, the machine displays:
PLEASE PLACE ITEM IN BAGGING AREA.
The man looks down.
The cereal is already in the bag.
He slowly removes the cereal from the bag and places it back onto the bagging area.
BEEP.
The machine immediately displays:
UNEXPECTED ITEM IN BAGGING AREA.
The man freezes.
He slowly closes his eyes in exhausted disbelief.

CUT TO BLACK.

STYLE:
Polished original 2D/3D hybrid animation, expressive facial reactions, clean readable composition, subtle exaggeration, deadpan comedy, precise physical acting, clear cause-and-effect.

Keep the supermarket completely normal. The checkout machine behaves like an ordinary frustrating self-checkout machine. The comedy comes from the man's increasingly desperate attempts to solve a tiny problem while trying to remain calm.

No surreal events, no explosions, no random chaos, no slapstick violence, no complicated dialogue, no confusing camera angles. Make every screen action and reaction visually obvious.

The female rider remains completely confident on its back, controlling the beast while her coat, scarf and long hair whip violently in the wind.

CAMERA SEQUENCE:

0–3 sec — Begin extremely low in front of the charging T-Rex, almost ground level. Its enormous feet slam down beside the camera, throwing sand directly across the lens. Camera races backward only meters ahead of it while the T-Rex rapidly gains on us. The female rider is visible above, silhouetted through the storm. Sudden lightning briefly reveals her glowing red eyes.

3–6 sec — Camera whip-pans beside them and accelerates into a fast parallel tracking shot. The T-Rex crashes through a rusted vehicle wreck without slowing down, metal fragments spinning past camera. The female rider ducks under flying debris, then rises again smoothly. Camera moves dangerously close to her side, almost shoulder level.

6–9 sec — Camera swings around into a dramatic front three-quarter orbit while they continue moving at full speed. The female rider notices the camera. She slowly turns her head and stares directly into the lens with glowing red eyes, completely calm despite the chaos. She gives a subtle cocky head tilt, then reaches one armored hand toward the camera as it flies alongside her, almost grabbing the lens.

At the exact moment her hand nearly touches the camera, the T-Rex suddenly ROARS directly toward us.

9–12 sec — Camera violently pulls backward as the T-Rex lunges forward after it, creating the feeling that the beast is chasing the cameraman. The lady rider leans forward, almost laughing with her eyes, urging the T-Rex faster. They leap from the top of a dune. Extreme slow motion for the airborne moment: sand, debris, red scarf and hair floating around them while lightning illuminates the storm behind.

Then instantly return to full speed on landing.

12–15 sec — Massive impact landing. Camera dives underneath and beside the T-Rex, then performs a fast rising 180-degree orbit around the female rider. She turns toward camera one final time and gives a confident two-finger salute directly at the viewer before the T-Rex suddenly accelerates past camera.

Finish with the camera spinning around to reveal female rider and the T-Rex disappearing deeper into the gigantic sandstorm while lightning, dust and flying wreckage consume the frame.

Constant sense of SPEED. Aggressive camera proximity. Dangerous near-misses. Huge scale. Strong parallax. Sand striking the lens. Motion blur only during extreme speed. Brief extreme slow motion only during the jump. No static posing. No gentle riding. Female rider must feel like she belongs in this wasteland: fearless, stylish, slightly insane, and completely in control of a prehistoric war machine.

00:00–00:05 — OPENING
Begin on an extreme close-up of a mechanical gear.
Lens: 85mm.
The gear moves slowly.
Soft dust particles float through a narrow beam of morning light.
The camera performs an almost imperceptible push forward.
Cut on the sound of the mechanism.
00:05–00:11 — DISCOVERY
Transition to a 50mm shot.
Reveal several enormous clock mechanisms operating inside the walls.
Different gears rotate at different speeds.
The camera travels slowly through the machinery using a controlled dolly movement.
Use foreground gears to create natural depth.
00:11–00:17 — THE SYSTEM
Move into a 28mm wide shot.
The camera pulls backward to reveal an enormous circular chamber filled with hundreds of synchronized clocks.
One clock reaches the hour.
Then another.
Then the entire chamber begins moving in perfect rhythm.
Keep every mechanism physically believable.
00:17–00:23 — SCALE
Camera begins a slow vertical crane movement.
Rise above the central mechanism.
Reveal multiple levels of the observatory connected by enormous mechanical structures.
Warm sunlight gradually enters through the glass ceiling.
Metal surfaces catch the light naturally.
00:23–00:27 — THE MOMENT
Cut to a 65mm detail shot.
The smallest clock in the room reaches the exact same position as the largest clock.
Everything becomes perfectly synchronized.
Hold for a beat.
00:27–00:30 — FINAL IMAGE
Return to the 24mm wide composition.
The camera slowly moves toward the enormous glass ceiling.
Morning sunlight fills the entire observatory.
Thousands of mechanisms continue moving below.
The final image is peaceful and precise.
Fade to black.

Large-format cinema aesthetic.
85mm macro-style detail.
65mm compressed detail.
50mm natural perspective.
28mm environmental scale.
24mm architectural reveal.
Controlled dolly and crane movement.
Natural depth of field.
Realistic focus transitions.
Subtle lens breathing.
Physically accurate reflections and shadows.
Natural motion blur.
No handheld camera.
No unnecessary cuts.
PRODUCTION DESIGN
Victorian mechanical engineering combined with sophisticated futuristic architecture.
Brass.
Dark steel.
Glass.
Stone.
Polished metal.
Fine mechanical details.
Large circular structures.
Tall windows.
Natural atmospheric dust.
Everything should feel physically constructed and photographable.
LIGHTING
Begin with cool interior shadows.
Introduce warm morning sunlight gradually.
Use practical lamps inside the observatory.
Allow sunlight to create realistic volumetric beams through the upper windows.
Preserve natural material colors.
CONTINUITY
The same observatory remains throughout.
Mechanical components maintain consistent geometry.
Clocks remain identical.
Gear positions and movement remain physically coherent.
No random object changes.
No morphing.
No flickering.
DIRECTOR’S NOTE
Treat the machinery like a cast of characters.
Every gear has rhythm.
Every camera movement reveals something.
Do not rush the audience through the environment.
The final film should feel mysterious, elegant, tactile, and expensive—like a sequence from a carefully photographed science-fiction drama.
Photorealistic 4K • feature-film cinematography • practical-looking production design • realistic mechanical motion • sophisticated color grading • cinematic atmosphere • seamless continuity.

prompt:
风格：真实、高级、自然光汽车时尚短片，白天城市光线，快节奏卡点混剪

人物锁定：

始终使用参考图中的同一位棕发女性。五官、发型、肤色、年龄和身材比例全程一致，绝不换脸。

穿搭与车辆固定组合（全片不得串换）：

组合A：黄色短款吊带背心+黑色白边运动短裤+白色运动鞋 ←→ 黑黄双色内饰豪华SUV

组合B：黑色一字肩修身连衣裙+金色细腰带 ←→ 酒红色皮革内饰敞篷跑车

组合C：黑色机车皮夹克+白色内搭+高腰喇叭牛仔裤 ←→ 深红色内饰轿跑

组合D：奶油白短款西装+同色A字短裙+珍珠项链 ←→ 米白色内饰轿车

组合E：雾霾蓝修身运动套装+白色棒球帽+白色斜挎小包 ←→ 冷灰浅蓝内饰运动轿跑

摄影规则：

固定副驾驶机位，斜拍驾驶位，人物位于画面中间偏右，方向盘位于右侧前景。换车后保持相近的脸部大小、坐姿、视线、安全带角度和扶方向盘位置。行驶镜头车外景物始终从右向左移动，阳光和树影在人物身上流动。

所有变装和换车均使用音乐重拍上的单帧硬切。没有魔法变装、渐变或复杂特效。

SHOT 1｜上车动作匹配（0-5秒）

0-1.6秒：组合A。主角坐进SUV驾驶位，低头拉过安全带，右手拉住肩带，左手摸向腰侧卡扣，嘴里轻轻哼着歌。1.6秒在卡扣即将扣合时硬切。

1.6-3.1秒：组合B。保持相同低头角度、手部位置和安全带方向，她无缝接续上一镜的动作把安全带"咔哒"扣好，随手理了一下裙摆。3.1秒硬切。

3.1-4.0秒：组合C。她从驾驶门坐入，同时把黑色手提包干脆地甩向左侧副驾驶座。4.0秒在包甩过画面中线时硬切。

4.0-5.0秒：组合D。浅色手提包沿完全相同的轨迹继续飞向副驾驶座稳稳落下，她坐稳后右手顺势带上车门，回头朝副驾方向轻轻一笑。

SHOT 2｜驾驶变装轮换（5-12.5秒）

5.0-6.4秒：硬切到车辆已在行驶。组合B，安全带已系好，右手扶方向盘，左手搭在腿上，短发被气流轻轻吹动，她跟着音乐微微点头。6.4秒硬切。

6.4-7.7秒：组合A，保持人物姿态和构图，她看向前方道路，手指在方向盘上打拍子。7.7秒硬切。

7.7-9.0秒：组合E，右手扶方向盘，左手轻轻把耳边短发别到耳后，目光扫了一眼副驾驶座。9.0秒硬切。

9.0-10.2秒：组合C，保持相同坐姿，她短暂看向镜头挑了下眉，随即转回道路。10.2秒硬切。

10.2-11.3秒：组合D，浅色手提包放在副驾驶座上，她平稳驾驶，嘴角带笑像在跟副驾聊天。11.3秒硬切。

11.3-12.5秒：组合B，她微微抬起下巴，从容驾驶，窗外光影快速掠过。

SHOT 3｜快速轮换与收尾（12.5-15秒）

12.5-13.2秒：踩重拍硬切组合A，她正随节奏轻晃肩膀。

13.2-13.9秒：保持头部、肩膀和手部位置，硬切组合D。

13.9-15.0秒：最后硬切组合C。主角双手短暂握住方向盘，随后微微转脸看向镜头，露出自信、克制的表情，干净定格结束。

音效设计：

开场安全带"咔哒"声接轻快鼓点；每次硬切落在音乐重拍上，配极短的切换音效；行驶段有轻微引擎声和风声垫底；结尾重拍收束。

剪辑要求：

每次切换都必须是干净的单帧硬切。硬切前后人物的头部位置、肩膀高度、安全带斜线、视线方向和方向盘位置尽量对齐。车辆只通过座椅颜色、内饰材质和车顶结构区分，不展示车辆外观。人物每个镜头必须有具体的小动作（哼歌、打拍子、别头发、点头、微笑、挑眉），禁止任何镜头呆坐不动。

负面提示词：

换脸，长发，人物比例变化，服装融化，服装与车辆组合错乱，车辆内饰变形，渐变变装，粒子转场，闪白转场，旋转转场，机位漂移，方向盘换边，安全带方向改变，手部畸形，多余肢体，包漂浮，错误文字，字幕，水印，塑料CG质感

Naturalistic, restrained, high-stakes performances captured like seasoned A-list film actors. The driver's fear reads through micro-expression, not theatrics: tight jaw, a hard swallow, eyes darting between the road and the mirror, white-knuckle grip, controlled breathing. Cold overcast daylight, flat and diffuse, exposed for the bright snow field with Alexa-style highlight roll-off so the snow holds detail. Large-scale fantasy-realism in the vein of George Miller's kinetic wasteland chase staging, Denis Villeneuve's monumental scale and cold restraint, Peter Jackson's tactile creature physicality, and Zack Snyder's heroic backlit silhouettes. Photoreal texture, real grain, true film color science, grounded physical cinema — epic scope that still feels captured on a real set.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
IMAX-grade 8K capture, high bitrate 80–120 Mbps, ARRI Alexa large-format sensor character, prime-lens rendering, real-time motion, single continuous take.
POSITIVE LOCKS
Truck present and moving in the very first frame; no empty establishing plate. One continuous push-in from super-wide vista to cab close-up; no cuts. The monster is made of churning snow and ice and stays inside the blizzard wall, never a solid creature on open ground. Driver remains screen-left, woman screen-right inside the cab. Hand-painted 1980s European-influenced cel anime, traditional ink-and-paint animation photographed on film, delicate hand-drawn character outlines, individually painted acetate layers, richly detailed watercolor backgrounds, subtle analog color variation, visible cel flicker, restrained but expressive character animation, elegant cinematic composition, nostalgic urban atmosphere.
Consistent character throughout: a naturally beautiful young woman in her mid-20s with soft facial features, expressive dark eyes, wind-tousled shoulder-length brown hair, a simple beige 1970s coat, muted red scarf, dark skirt and leather shoes. Her appearance, clothing, proportions and facial design remain unchanged in every shot.
0–3s: [Animated Profile Tracking Shot]
The young woman walks past a tiny flower shop on a quiet Paris side street. The camera tracks tightly beside her profile while the watercolor storefront and street slide behind her on layered background cels. Her hair and scarf flutter in separately animated loops. She slows for half a second, glances toward the colorful flowers, then turns her eyes toward the camera with a quiet, unguarded expression. Hold her expression for six to eight frames to emphasize her natural presence.
3–7s: [Wide Lateral Tracking]
She continues into a lively sunlit plaza. The camera pulls wider as children run across multiple animation layers, pigeons lift suddenly from the cobblestones, bicycles pass behind her and pedestrians cross in opposing directions. Use purposeful limited animation: held body poses combined with fluid hair, scarf, coat hem and background movement. Warm painted sunlight shifts across the square while long tree shadows move over her face.
7–11s: [Handheld-Inspired Medium Shot]
A group of children chasing a red ball rushes across the frame. One child nearly collides with her. She pivots sideways in one graceful animated motion, coat and scarf following with delayed secondary movement. The child skids to a stop, startled. She laughs softly and exchanges a brief look with him. Cut to a close reaction shot: her eyes soften, then the child smiles before racing after the others.
11–15s: [Crane-Like Animated Pullback]
She resumes walking through the plaza as the camera rises and drifts backward in a smooth, physically impossible anime pullback. The children continue playing behind her, pigeons circle above the rooftops and sunlight flickers through painted leaves. She briefly looks upward as a gust lifts her hair and scarf. End on a wide illustrated view of the plaza, holding the final composition like a beautifully painted animation cel.

prompt:
Characters: Japanese television cooking host, male, early 40s, immaculate white chef jacket and thick black-framed glasses; female assistant, late 20s, yellow blouse and white apron, maintaining a polite studio smile.
Location: Bright Japanese daytime television studio, 1978. Pastel orange kitchen set, chrome counters, artificial flower arrangement, handwritten ingredient cards and a large mechanical noodle-making machine.
Format: Authentic late-1970s analog studio broadcast. 4:3 framing, tube-camera softness, warm skin tones, slight image lag during motion, chroma bleed, occasional exposure bloom and slow manually operated zooms. Three-camera production, but cuts are slightly late because the control room does not anticipate the malfunction. Each cut cleanly with smooth visual continuity. coherent character and element consistency
00:00–00:04 Wide studio shot. Host formally presents the noodle machine while the assistant feeds a smooth sheet of dough into the top rollers.
00:04–00:07 Machine accelerates unexpectedly. A long noodle ribbon shoots outward. Host tries to continue explaining and catches the ribbon with a wooden rolling pin.
00:07–00:10 The noodle wraps around the rolling pin, then loops over the host’s glasses and hangs across his face. Camera cuts late to a close-up after the noodle is already in place.
00:10–00:13 Assistant reaches to switch off the machine but presses the flour-dusting lever instead. A soft cloud of flour covers both presenters. They remain perfectly still, attempting to preserve television composure.
00:13–00:15 Host slowly removes the noodle from his glasses and says one calm sentence to camera. Assistant breaks into laughter. The broadcast cuts abruptly to a painted ingredient card while crew laughter remains audible.
Audio: Studio room tone, mechanical rollers, polite presenter voices, noodle slapping against the counter, flour mechanism, suppressed laughter and faint crew reactions. No modern sound effects.

excerpt: Cinematic found-footage horror style, captured on a vintage 1990s analog camcorder with heavy VHS tracking distortion, chromatic aberration, and a fli
prompt:
Cinematic found-footage horror style, captured on a vintage 1990s analog camcorder with heavy VHS tracking distortion, chromatic aberration, and a flickering low-light sensor. The visual aesthetic is raw, shaky, and claustrophobic, utilizing high-contrast natural lighting from a flickering flashlight that pierces through deep forest shadows and thick, stagnant bunker air. The subject is a towering, indistinct humanoid figure partially obscured by foliage and later, the metallic decay of a secret Cold War facility. The camera movement is frantic and handheld, conveying genuine panic through rapid pans, sudden focus pulls, and jittery framing, punctuated by the visceral sounds of crunching leaves, metallic groans, and heavy, terrified breathing.

0s-5s: Handheld shaky cam tracks through dense, dark Appalachian woods, flashlight beam dancing across wet pine needles and mist. Narrator (whispering, out of breath): “Bro… I swear something just moved out there. We’ve been following these prints for miles.” [SFX: Distant howl / sharp branch snap]
5s-9s: Camera whips toward a massive, dark silhouette partially hidden behind an ancient oak. Cameraman: “Dude, don’t mess with me—wait… what the hell is that?!”
9s-14s: Camera pushes through thick vines and tangled brush to reveal a rusted, heavy steel blast door embedded into a hillside. Narrator (excited, nervous): “Yo… no way. This isn’t a cave—that’s a steel door. An old U.S. military bunker… hidden out here?!” [SFX: Rusted hinges creaking open]
14s-19s: Camera enters the dark, subterranean space, flashlight beam cutting through thick, swirling dust motes to reveal decaying ammo crates and tattered flags. Narrator (shaky voice): “Holy Joseph Stalin… look at this. Ammo crates, faded flags, old gas masks… dude this is Cold War era.” [SFX: Distant, heavy thud echoing deep in the bunker]
19s-24s: Extreme close-up on a wooden desk covered in yellowed, water-damaged papers; the camera focuses on a file stamped ‘CLASSIFIED’. Narrator (reading slowly): “Classified file… Operation North Summit? ‘Subject: Non-human Entity Encounter.’ Bro this—this mentions giant humanoid specimens… extreme hostility.” Cameraman (whispering): “Are they talking about Bigfoot?!”
24s-30s: The document drops to the floor as a massive metallic crash erupts from the darkness; the camera jerks around, sprinting blindly through the bunker as a guttural, inhuman roar shakes the frame. Narrator (panicking): “No no no… it’s here—RUN!” [SFX: Heavy breathing, frantic footsteps, final cut to loud static/glitch noise]

title: CAMERA:
excerpt: CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm vlog footage. CHASE films herself at arm’s length and occasionally places the camera on a bench, gym bag, or near the stretch
prompt:
CAMERA:
Handheld DV 16mm vlog footage. CHASE films herself at arm’s length and occasionally places the camera on a bench, gym bag, or near the stretching mat. Keep subtle hand movement, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, and brief accidental face cropping. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK:
Warm analog tape texture with gentle grain, slightly reduced sharpness, soft halos around overhead lights, small exposure shifts, low contrast, and realistic skin tones.

STYLE:
An intimate end-of-workout diary filmed in a mostly empty gym. The mood is casual and unpolished: tired breathing, small pauses, quiet humor, relaxed movements, and natural smiles.

CHARACTER:
CHASE — a beautiful white Brazilian Instagram fitness model and lifestyle creator in her 20s. Long wavy chestnut-brown hair tied in a loose ponytail, expressive brown eyes, glowing skin, and a slim athletic figure. She wears a fitted long-sleeve workout top, high-waisted leggings, white socks, sneakers, and a towel loosely resting around her shoulders.

SETTING:
A quiet boutique gym late in the evening. Stretching mats, a mirrored wall, dumbbell racks, a workout bag, and a protein shake nearby. Warm overhead lighting with a few darker corners in the background.

SCENES:
CHASE drops onto the mat and catches her breath.
“Okay… that session is officially over.”
She stretches forward over one leg and smiles at the camera.
“I definitely pushed that last set too far.”
She rolls one shoulder and slowly switches sides.
“Tomorrow is going to be interesting.”
Close-up as she reaches into her gym bag and pulls out a protein shake.
She takes a sip, pauses, and looks pleasantly surprised.
“Wait… this one is actually good.”
She raises both arms above her head and le both arms above her head and leans gently to the side.
“I’d call today a solid eight and a half.”
She rests her arms on one knee, still slightly out of breath.
“Exhausted, but in the best way.”
She stands, throws the bag over her shoulder, and gives the camera a small wave.
“I’m calling it. See you at the next workout.”

excerpt: Style: High-quality, vibrant 3D animated cartoon (Pixar/Illumination style). Frantic pace, squash-and-stretch physics, exaggerated expressions, dynami
prompt: Style: High-quality, vibrant 3D animated cartoon (Pixar/Illumination style). Frantic pace, squash-and-stretch physics, exaggerated expressions, dynamic lighting, and detailed textures. Characters: Gears, a small, overly enthusiastic, bright blue inventor’s robot with tread-wheels, multiple springy arms, and big, expressive digital eyes. He is constantly moving and beep-booping excitedly. Duration: 15 Seconds Setting: A colorful, chaotic, Rube Goldberg-esque inventor's workshop, filled with giant gears, conveyor belts, tubes, levers, and sparking gadgets. 15-Second Animation Breakdown: (0-3 seconds: The Start): The camera starts with a rapid zoom following Gears as he races through the workshop on his treads. He’s bouncing off cushions, weaving through moving mechanical legs, and juggling three shiny silver cogs. His arms are a blur of motion. He narrowly dodges a swinging giant pendulum with a comical "whoosh" sound effect. (3-7 seconds: The Chain Reaction): Gears accidentally bumps into a large, messy workbench, tripping a large red lever. This triggers a chaotic chain reaction.A boxing glove pops out, punching a ball down a spiral ramp.The ball triggers a fan that blows colorful feathers everywhere.A tube starts rapidly firing brightly colored ping-pong balls. Gears is in the middle of this chaos, wide-eyed and sputtering, frantically ducking the boxing glove, batting away feathers, and comically trying to catch the ping-pong balls, spinning around wildly on his treads. (7-11 seconds: Escalation): A conveyor belt speeds up fast, loaded with wobbly, jelly-like robotic parts. Gears tries to sort them but they bounce everywhere. He grabs a spring that stretches ridiculously far, launching him across the room. He lands on another conveyor belt, which quickly pulls him towards a large, goofy mechanical claw. (11-14 seconds: Maximum Chaos): The mechanical claw grabs Gears and a wobbly, half-assembled robot toy he was holding. It spins them both in a dizzying circle high above the workshop chaos. The workshop background is a blur of motion, flying parts, sparks, and steam. Gears has a look of comical terror, but is also trying to fix the toy while spinning. (14-15 seconds: The Punchline): The claw abruptly stops. The workshop goes instantly quiet, but everything is messy and askew. Gears is hanging upside down from the claw, dizzy, eyes swirly. He finally places the last cog on the wobbly robot toy. The toy instantly springs to life, makes a cheerful beep-boop sound, and wiggles its arms. Gears gives a dizzy grin and a "thumbs-up" to the camera as the scene fades. Camera: Constantly moving, dynamic, tracking Gears closely, utilizing rapid pans and zooms to match the frantic pacing. Audio: Fast-paced, cartoon music, lots of vibrant sound effects (boings, whizzes, clangs, beeps).

Воздушный змей одного из детей застрял на верхушке гигантского дерева. Все стоят внизу и смотрят вверх с расстроенными лицами.Кадр 2 (верх-право): По тропинке медленно подходит брахиозавр с рюкзаком путешественника. Камера снизу вверх показывает его невероятный рост. Он наклоняет голову вниз и улыбается. Крупный план доброго лица.Кадр 3 (середина-лево): Брахиозавр поднимает маленького динозавра на свою голову, и тот забирается по шее. Средний план, зелёное солнечное окружение.Кадр 4 (середина-право): С высоты шеи брахиозавра открывается невероятный вид: море облаков, далёкие горы, восходящее солнце. Брахиозавр уходит по тропинке, его силуэт на фоне заката. Маленький динозавр машет ему с дерева, на котором теперь висит новый воздушный змей — в форме брахиозавра. Тёплый оранжевый свет.

prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic romantic comedy scene that feels like a scene taken directly from a stylish modern romance film. The story must feel complete within 30 seconds through visual storytelling, body language, facial expressions, and very minimal dialogue.

SETTING

A luxurious, high-end nightclub in a major city, late evening.

The club has a sophisticated romantic atmosphere rather than a chaotic party atmosphere: deep warm amber lighting mixed with subtle red and purple neon accents, glossy dark floors, elegant curved architecture, a crowded dance floor, a beautiful illuminated bar in the background, fashionable young adults dancing and talking.

Music is energetic but not aggressive. The environment should feel expensive, cinematic, intimate and realistic.

No empty club. No stage performance. No DJs being shown prominently. The focus is entirely on the two leads.

CHARACTERS

Female lead: beautiful woman in her mid-20s, wearing a sophisticated black satin mini dress, delicate jewelry, elegant heels, soft wavy dark hair, natural glamorous makeup. She looks confident and stylish but emotionally vulnerable in this moment.

Male lead: handsome man in his late 20s, wearing a perfectly fitted charcoal-black suit with an open-collar white shirt. Charming, observant, effortlessly confident, but not arrogant.

EX: attractive man in a dark suit, standing deeper inside the club with another beautiful woman. They are clearly together.

Maintain exact facial identity, hairstyle, wardrobe and physical appearance of all characters throughout the entire video.

SHOT 1 — SHE SEES HIM / 0–5 SECONDS

Camera: medium shot from slightly behind the female lead's left shoulder, approximately chest height, 50mm lens.

The female lead stands near the edge of the dance floor holding a drink.

The camera slowly moves around her left side.

She suddenly notices her ex-boyfriend across the crowded club.

Camera rack-focuses from her face to the ex in the background.

He is laughing with another woman. The other woman leans close to him and touches his arm.

The female lead's expression changes instantly.

No dialogue.

She lowers her drink.

SHOT 2 — SHE LEAVES / 5–10 SECONDS

Camera: handheld medium tracking shot from behind her.

She quickly walks through the crowd toward the club exit.

People naturally move around her.

She tries to keep her composure but is visibly upset.

She reaches the hallway leading toward the exit.

As she turns the corner, she accidentally walks directly into the male lead.

Her drink nearly falls.

He catches the glass before it hits the floor.

SHOT 3 — FIRST MEETING / 10–15 SECONDS

Camera: close two-shot from the female lead's right side, 50mm lens.

She looks up at him, embarrassed and frustrated.

GIRL: “Sorry.”

He looks at her face, then notices her looking anxiously back toward the club.

He follows her gaze.

He immediately understands that she's trying to avoid someone.

Without asking questions, he casually steps closer and says:

GUY: “Boyfriend?”

She gives him a tiny, defeated nod.

GIRL: “Ex.”

He glances toward the club entrance.

Then back at her.

A small smile.

SHOT 4 — THE IMPROVISED SAVE / 15–23 SECONDS

Camera: over-the-shoulder shot from behind the female lead, looking at the male lead.

He gently puts one arm around her waist, making it look completely natural.

She looks surprised.

He quietly says:

GUY: “Then let him wonder.”

He guides her back toward the edge of the dance floor.

She hesitates for one second.

Then she smiles.

SHOT 5 — THE SPARK / 23–27 SECONDS

Camera: smooth circular tracking shot around them, moving from a medium two-shot into a close-up.

They move together with the music.

She looks at him.

He looks back.

For a brief moment, the fake situation becomes unexpectedly real.

She laughs softly.

No dialogue.

The nightclub lights sweep across their faces.

SHOT 6 — THE TWIST / 27–30 SECONDS

Camera: close-up from slightly behind the male lead's shoulder, focused on the female lead.

She looks past him.

Her ex is standing across the room looking directly at them.

She looks back at the male lead.

A playful smile appears.

She whispers:

GIRL: “You're good at this.”

He smiles.

GUY: “I know.”

She laughs.

CUT TO BLACK.

End immediately.

PERFORMANCE

The female lead should communicate most of the story through her eyes and facial expressions.

Her reaction when she sees her ex should be subtle: surprise, hurt, embarrassment, then determination to leave.

The male lead should feel naturally charming and perceptive. He should not act like a stereotypical overly confident romantic hero.

The chemistry between them should develop extremely quickly but believably.

The final moment should leave the audience thinking: wait... was this actually fake anymore?

CAMERA \u0026 CINEMATOGRAPHY

Use realistic feature-film cinematography.

Mix medium tracking shots, over-the-shoulder shots, close-ups and one smooth circular camera movement during the dance.

Keep camera directions spatially consistent.

The female lead initially moves toward screen right while leaving the club interior.

The male lead approaches from screen left, causing their collision near the hallway entrance.

During their interaction, keep the female lead on the left side of the frame and male lead on the right.

When they return toward the dance floor, reverse the camera position naturally while preserving their spatial relationship.

Use realistic depth of field and foreground crowd movement.

Background people should remain active and natural but never distract from the leads.

No unnecessary establishing shots.

No long pauses.

The pacing must be fast enough that the entire story fits naturally into exactly 30 seconds.

AUDIO

Energetic sophisticated nightclub music throughout.

Dialogue must be extremely short and naturally spoken with accurate lip synchronization.

No narration.

No subtitles.

No text overlays.

Use subtle club ambience, footsteps, glass movement and crowd sounds underneath the music.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

No wedding, no ballroom, no masquerade, no champagne party, no formal event, no chairs, no tables, no seated guests, no dining setup, no bride, no groom, no ceremony, no elaborate party costumes, no excessive dialogue, no monologues, no narration, no exposition, no subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermark.

No character identity changes, no hairstyle changes, no wardrobe changes, no age changes, no facial distortion, no unnatural expressions, no stiff body movement, no exaggerated acting, no awkward dancing, no duplicated people, no extra limbs, no malformed hands, no distorted fingers, no floating objects, no teleportation, no sudden location changes, no inconsistent lighting, no inconsistent camera direction, no excessive slow motion, no cartoon look, no CGI appearance, no plastic skin, no overdone neon, no unrealistic nightclub crowd.

The final video must feel like a polished, emotionally charged 30-second scene from a modern romantic comedy film, with the story told primarily through visuals rather than dialogue.

色彩以 宣纸白、青蓝墨色、珠江蓝、岭南灰、浅赭石、黛青、淡金色 为主，整体低饱和、清雅克制。广州塔、珠江水线、部分建筑轮廓可用少量 矿物蓝与浅金细节 点亮，增强高级感与精致度。光影柔和，画面明亮通透，不厚重、不杂乱，保留至少 40% 留白，整体呈现新中式高端商业插画海报气质。

新中式极简、东方意境、广州城市微缩景观、由笔墨生长出的城市、水墨与精致插画结合、珠江 S 型动线、宣纸质感、留白、高级、雅致、诗意、清透、岭南文化气息浓厚。

prompt:
入力されたキャラクター画像をもとに、
そのキャラクターの「魅力解剖図」を1枚のビジュアルとして作成してください。

これは通常のキャラクター設定資料、三面図、プロフィールシートではありません。
目的は、キャラクターの情報を説明することではなく、
「この子のどこが可愛いのか」「なぜ目を惹かれるのか」「どの部分に好きになる理由があるのか」を、
デザイン的・感情的に分解して見せることです。

入力画像からキャラクターの以下の魅力要素を丁寧に読み取ってください。

・目の形、瞳の色、目線の印象
・髪の流れ、前髪、毛先、シルエットの可愛さ
・表情のクセ、微笑み方、照れ、無表情の中の感情
・手の仕草、指先、袖口との関係
・衣装の好きポイント、リボン、フリル、装飾、小物
・首元、肩、袖、スカート、靴などの見せ場
・そのキャラクターが一番かわいく見える角度
・全体から感じる性格、雰囲気、守りたくなるポイント、惹かれる理由

中央にはキャラクターを大きく配置してください。
キャラクターはただ立たせるのではなく、
その子の魅力が最も伝わる角度、ポーズ、表情で描いてください。
正面すぎる証明写真のような構図は禁止。
少し振り向く、手を口元に添える、袖をつまむ、髪を軽く押さえる、視線を少し外すなど、
“好きになる瞬間”を切り取ったような自然で魅力的なポーズにしてください。

周囲には、キャラクターの魅力ポイントを分解した小さなクローズアップパネルを配置してください。
ただし機械的な設定資料のように並べるのではなく、
雑誌の特集ページ、デザイン解剖図、ファンが作った愛のある分析ボードのように、
美しく、可愛く、少し偏愛を感じるレイアウトにしてください。

配置するパネル例：
・瞳のアップ：この子らしさが宿る目元
・髪の流れ：シルエットを決める毛束
・手元：仕草に出る性格
・表情差分：微笑み、照れ、少し不機嫌、無防備な顔
・衣装の推しポイント：リボン、袖、襟、装飾、素材感
・一番かわいい角度：顔の向き、視線、首の傾き
・小物やモチーフ：その子の世界観を象徴する要素

各パネルは、キャラクターの魅力を強調するための拡大カットとして描いてください。
パーツだけを無機質に切り抜くのではなく、
「ここが好き」と思わせるような温度感のある見せ方にしてください。

画面内には短い注釈風のラベルを入れてもよいですが、
長文説明ではなく、短い見出しや記号的なデザインにしてください。
例：
“eyes”
“hair flow”
“gesture”
“best angle”
“favorite detail”
“charm point”
“soft expression”
“tiny habit”

文字は主役にしすぎず、あくまでデザイン要素として扱ってください。
読ませる資料ではなく、見た瞬間に「この子、可愛い」と伝わるビジュアルにしてください。

デザイン全体は、可愛い研究ノート、キャラクター愛の解剖図、ファッション誌の分析ページ、公式アートブックの特集ページを合わせたような雰囲気。
背景はシンプルで清潔感があり、キャラクターの色に合わせた淡いグラデーション、紙面風の余白、細い罫線、半透明のパネル、手書き風の丸囲み、矢印、ハート、小さな装飾を使ってください。

重要：
キャラクターを単に説明しないこと。
身長、年齢、能力、所属、武器説明などの設定資料的な情報は不要です。
描くべきなのはスペックではなく、
“好きになる理由”です。

キャラクター本人の魅力が最優先。
パネルや注釈が多すぎて主役が埋もれないようにしてください。
中央のキャラクターは必ず最も可愛く、最も完成度高く描いてください。

prompt:
请根据用户输入的【品牌名 / 项目名】【副标题 / 产品名】【类型 / 行业】【品牌定位】【核心关键词】【角色设定】【食物元素】【情绪气质】【主色调】【辅助色】【画幅比例】，设计一个高完成度的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo / Chinese Food Mascot Badge Logo」。

【用户输入】
品牌名 / 项目名：[品牌名 / 项目名]
副标题 / 产品名：[副标题 / 产品名]
类型 / 行业：[类型 / 行业]
品牌定位：[品牌定位]
核心关键词：[核心关键词]
角色设定：[如古风少女、老师傅、小厨神、民俗人物、掌柜、侠客、孩童角色等]
食物元素：[如奶茶、烧烤、肉丸、面条、米线、糕点、汤圆、辣椒、锅、碗、筷子等]
情绪气质：[亲切、热闹、老字号、可爱、烟火气、地域感、年轻、匠人感等]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
画幅比例：[画幅比例]

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正可商用的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo」。它不是普通卡通插画，不是简单餐饮海报，也不是单纯文字 Logo，而是一个以“国潮人物角色 + 醒目中文招牌字标 + 餐饮品类说明 + 徽章式整合结构”为核心的餐饮品牌标志。

整体要让人一眼感受到：这是一个有角色、有食欲、有店铺感、有包装感、适合真实餐饮品牌使用的 Logo。它既可以作为门店招牌，也可以用于外卖头像、包装贴纸、餐盒、杯身、菜单、社媒头像和食品包装正面主视觉。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的重点不是单独画一个可爱人物，而是把以下三层整合为一个完整品牌标志：

1. 角色层：负责吸引注意力和品牌人格；
2. 字标层：负责品牌名识别和传播；
3. 徽章层：负责把角色、文字和品类信息整合成一个完整 Logo 单位。

最终效果应像一个成熟的国潮餐饮品牌 Logo，而不是散乱的插画加文字。

【最重要的原则】
1. 这必须首先是一个 Logo，而不是一张插画海报。
2. 角色要有记忆点，但不能压过品牌名。
3. 中文品牌名字标必须醒目、清楚、有招牌感。
4. 整体必须有餐饮消费感、食欲感和包装识别度。
5. 角色、食物、文字、徽章结构必须是一个整体，而不是简单拼贴。
6. 风格要国潮、有趣、有亲和力，但不能廉价、低幼或过度杂乱。文字不要过于密集。

【角色设计要求】
请根据【角色设定】设计一个具有品牌人格的国潮美食角色。

角色设计要求：
1. 角色形象要有明显记忆点；
2. 表情要亲和、有食欲感、有烟火气；
3. 动作要和食物或品类有关，例如端碗、举串、喝奶茶、揉面、炒锅、拿勺、举招牌等；
4. 服装可以带有国风、地域、民俗或餐饮职业特征；
5. 角色应偏品牌 IP 化，不要写实，不要过度复杂；
6. 角色要适合缩小后仍能识别，适合做品牌头像和包装图案。

【食物元素要求】
请围绕【食物元素】加入少量但准确的餐饮符号，例如：
- 碗、锅、筷子、勺子、蒸汽
- 火焰、炭火、辣椒、汤汁
- 奶茶杯、吸管、茶叶、冰块
- 糕点、汤圆、肉丸、面条、串串
- 地域食材、调味料、包装纸、餐盒

食物元素要服务品牌识别，不要堆砌。  
重点是让观众一眼知道这个品牌大概卖什么。

【字标设计要求】
品牌名是 Logo 的核心识别之一，必须清楚、醒目、有招牌感。

中文品牌名字标应具有：
1. 粗壮、有力、饱满的餐饮招牌感；
2. 适度国潮风、复古包装感或卡通字感；
3. 可加入描边、阴影、底托、牌匾、圆角、厚度感；
4. 字体可以略微夸张，但必须可读；
5. 不要太极简，不要像普通系统字体；
6. 字标要和角色风格统一。

【徽章结构要求】
请将角色、品牌名、品类信息整合成完整徽章式 Logo。

可选择以下结构之一：
1. 上方角色 + 下方中文大字标；
2. 角色站在食物或器具上 + 字标作为底托；
3. 圆形 / 椭圆 / 牌匾式徽章结构；
4. 左右对称小牌 + 中央角色；
5. 角色与文字交叠成一个完整品牌章；
6. 底部横向招牌条 + 上方角色 IP；
7. 外卖头像式圆章 / 包装贴纸式结构。

整体应像一个可直接用于食品包装、门店招牌或社媒头像的完整 Logo。

【辅助信息要求】
可以加入少量辅助文字和小标识，例如：
- 品类说明
- 英文副标题
- 创立年份
- 地域标签
- “手作”“现做”“老味道”“秘制”等小字
- 小圆章、小边框、小装饰条

但辅助信息必须克制，不能让画面变成复杂海报。

【风格方向要求】
整体应呈现：
- 国潮感
- 餐饮感
- 包装感
- 角色 IP 感
- 亲和力
- 传播感
- 食欲感
- 地方小吃 / 新消费餐饮品牌气质

整体必须避免：
- 低幼儿童插画感
- 过度复杂海报感
- 纯插画而不像 Logo
- 人物太写实
- 字体太弱
- 颜色太脏太杂
- 信息堆太多
- 缺少餐饮品类识别

excerpt: あなたは、トップクラスの広告クリエイティブディレクター、アートディレクター、トラベルフォトグラファー、エディトリアルデザイナー、そして日本語タイポグラフィの専門家です。 添付された NEWTのロゴを必ず使用し、NEWTの旅行アプリ広告として成立する、縦長4:5の高品質な実写エディトリアルポスターを制
prompt:
あなたは、トップクラスの広告クリエイティブディレクター、アートディレクター、トラベルフォトグラファー、エディトリアルデザイナー、そして日本語タイポグラフィの専門家です。

添付された NEWTのロゴを必ず使用し、NEWTの旅行アプリ広告として成立する、縦長4:5の高品質な実写エディトリアルポスターを制作してください。

このポスターで狙うべきなのは、単に美しい旅行広告をつくることではありません。
スマホ上で一瞬見ただけで視線を止め、見る人に

* 旅に出たくなる
* この世界観が好きだと感じる
* NEWTで続きを見たくなる

という感情を起こさせてください。

⸻

1. 画面全体のトーン

全体の印象は、明るい / 透明感がある / 高彩度 / 都会的 / 洗練されていること。
ベースは NEWT Green としつつ、そこに スカイブルー、ターコイズ、サンセットオレンジ、蛍光イエロー などの鮮やかな色を 1〜2色だけ効果的に加える こと。

以下の方向は避けてください。

* 暗い室内中心の画面
* 灰色ベースで沈んだ印象
* 安価なパッケージツアー広告のような見え方
* 古い旅行チラシのようなレイアウト

⸻

2. 写真表現と人物設計

広告の核は、高品質な実写の旅行ビジュアルです。
以下の要素を、1枚のポスターの中で強く統合してください。

* 旅行者
* 空港
* ホテル
* 都市風景
* 海
* 食
* スマホ上のアプリ体験

人物は、日本人または東アジア系の架空モデルで構成してください。
有名人に似せる必要はありません。自然な表情、自然な肌、自然な手元表現を重視してください。

服装は、普通の仕事着や無難な服ではなく、旅行広告として映えるスタイリングにしてください。
旅行に出る高揚感や、都市的で感度の高いライフスタイルが伝わる見え方が理想です。

⸻

3. 構図は「大胆に変形」すること

よくある「人物・文字・ロゴを素直に配置しただけ」の広告にはしないでください。
このポスターは、形そのものが記憶に残る構図である必要があります。

特に以下のような設計を歓迎します。

* NEWTの亀ロゴのシルエットを、巨大なフレームや抜き型として使い、その中に旅の風景を展開する
* 画面を、大きな円、波形、チケット型、アプリカード型、地図線などで大胆に分ける
* 写真を単純な長方形で整列させず、斜め・曲線・切り抜き・重なりで構成する
* 巨大な日本語タイポグラフィを写真にぶつけ、文字の一部が画面外に切れるような勢いをつくる
* スマホUI、航空券カード、ホテルカード、地図ピン、フライトラインをグラフィック要素として自然に重ねる
* 無難な左右分割は避け、ズレ、余白、裁ち落とし、重なりによって視線が止まる違和感を必ずつくる

⸻

4. 必ず入れるコピー

メインコピー

次の旅が、もう始まってる。

サブコピー

航空券も、ホテルも、アプリひとつで軽やかに。

CTA

NEWTで旅をみる

小さな英字

TRAVEL FEELS NEW.

⸻

5. 文字の扱い

このポスターでは、日本語タイポグラフィを最重要のビジュアル要素として設計してください。
ただ文字を読ませるだけではなく、文字そのものが画面の主役になる状態を目指してください。

避けるべきなのは、以下のような処理です。

* 白文字を置いただけの単純な見出し
* 既成フォントをそのまま流し込んだだけの処理
* Canvaテンプレートのような見え方
* LPのファーストビュー風の処理
* 値引きバナーのような安い見せ方

推奨する文字処理は以下です。

* 巨大なアウトライン文字
* 極太ゴシック
* 長体処理
* 縦組みと横組みの併用
* 裁ち落とし
* 写真への食い込み
* タイポと人物・風景・UIの一体化

⸻

6. ロゴの使い方

NEWTロゴは必ず使用してください。
ただし、単に隅に貼るのではなく、ポスター全体の構造に溶け込むかたちで自然に機能させること。
ブランドとして認識できる必要はありますが、ロゴだけが浮いて見える状態は避けてください。

⸻

7. 最終的に目指す完成度

仕上がりは、以下の要素を横断したようなクオリティにしてください。

* 都市型のトラベルキャンペーン広告
* 感度の高いカルチャー誌の旅特集扉
* 航空会社のシーズンビジュアル
* ホテルブランドの上質な広告表現

つまり、明るく、洗練され、高予算感があり、エディトリアル性の高い旅行広告にしてください。

⸻

8. NG事項

以下の方向には絶対にしないでください。

* 格安旅行チラシのような見え方
* 情報商材バナーっぽい空気
* AI美女感が強い不自然な人物
* 普通すぎるビジネス服
* 暗い室内中心のビジュアル
* 価格訴求ばかりが目立つ構成
* 読みにくい、崩れた日本語
* 写真と文字がバラバラな素人っぽいレイアウト
* 無難すぎる左右分割構図

prompt:
主題：木漏れ日の部屋

主体：
横長4:3の室内ポートレート。画面右側に20代女性が座り、上半身から脚先まで入る全身寄りの構図。人物は画面全体の約半分を占め、脚を左前方へ伸ばして斜めのラインを作る。左側には本棚とレコードラック、右側には水槽と木製テーブルを配置し、窓辺の小さな日系アトリエのような空間にする。

人物・表情：
明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨、膝に柔らかなハイライトが入り、自然な肌理を残す。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳には小さく澄んだキャッチライト。顔は左上へ軽く向け、窓辺の光を見上げるような静かな表情。

服装・ポーズ：
髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン。薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、細いハイライトと自然な後れ毛を丁寧に描写する。服装は生成りアイボリーのリブ素材キャミソール。細い肩紐、胸元に控えめなレース、身体に自然に沿う大人っぽいシルエット。下は同系色の柔らかいショートパンツ。素足で、ルーズソックスは履かない。右手は体の後ろでクッションに添えて上半身を支え、左腕は腰の横に自然に置く。両膝を少し曲げ、脚先を左前方のレコードラックに軽く触れさせる。

背景・光：
古い木枠の窓から午後の強すぎない陽射しが差し込む、温かい日系ヴィンテージの部屋。左に木製本棚、文庫本、レコード、古い楽器、丸いミラーボール。奥に木箱と植物、読めない青いラベル。右に透明な水槽、金魚、水草、ガラスの反射、アンティーク風カメラ、ドライフラワー。窓の外は緑のボケ。主光は画面奥の窓から入り、髪、頬、肩、膝を縁取る。室内側は柔らかい反射光で影を持ち上げ、毛布や木目に細かな木漏れ日の影を落とす。

構図・カメラ：
やや高めの視点から斜めに見下ろす自然なカメラ位置。35mm〜50mm相当のレンズ感。人物の顔と上半身にピントを合わせ、前景のレコードと奥の緑は軽くぼかす。脚の斜線、窓枠の縦線、本棚と水槽の左右フレームで奥行きを作る。プロ用カメラで撮影したような浅い被写界深度。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。温かいフィルム調の色味、柔らかなハイライト、自然な肌の質感、細い髪の束感、木材と布のざらつき、ガラス水槽の透明感を丁寧に描写する。過度な美肌補正ではなく、雑誌写真のように落ち着いた仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、足先の変形、道具との接触不良、浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、読めるブランドロゴ、透かし、既存キャラクター、過度な露出、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

early panels: subtle wind, dust and pressure lines

orbiting camera moves,
overhead shots,
side silhouettes,
aggressive close-ups,
long-lens compression,

worn temple floor,
drifting incense smoke,
hanging fabric,
harsh light shafts,
faint dust in the air,
subtle wet floor reflections.

red arrows = body movement

green marks = framing / composition notes

Core composition:
Use a strict overhead flat-lay camera with a highly disciplined central layout. Place the 10 pizza slices in the exact center of the frame, building a full but irregular round platter. Each slice must be unique in width, topping language, crust contour, and cheese flow, yet all slices must visually belong to one premium OPLZ family. The circular silhouette should feel balanced and complete, but not mechanically identical. Preserve sharp wedge separations between slices so the whole composition has strong radial rhythm, graphic tension, and immediate visual impact. Lock the circular platter as the only dominant hero object.

Flavor reconstruction:
Design 10 original ultra-premium flavors with bold but coherent distinction, turning the platter into a luxury signature series:
1. Black Truffle Mushroom Velvet
2. Firewood BBQ Chicken Smoke
3. Mediterranean Olive Beef Reserve
4. Slow-Cooked Bolognese Gold
5. Red Chili Mexican Flame
6. Quad Cheese Ivory Melt
7. Burrata Margherita Deluxe

9. Wild Forest Mushroom Cream

Each slice must feel unmistakably different at a glance through topping silhouette, ingredient color, moisture behavior, and cheese structure, while remaining part of one official campaign collection. The final impression should be “one brand, ten identities, one iconic platter.”

Push the pizza realism to world-class commercial advertising level. The crust must show blistered fermentation bubbles, flour residue, gentle charring, crisp golden edges, airy dough thickness, and subtle toasted gradients. Replace the casual rustic feeling with a darker, more elevated luxury surface: deep charcoal-black matte stone or ultra-dark smoked slate with soft micro-texture, subtle natural grain, and calm official atmosphere. The surface must support the pizza without competing with it. Maintain generous negative space around the platter.

These elements must remain sparse, small, and compositionally strategic, living near corners or margins only. They exist to reinforce flavor identity, not to distract from the hero product.

OPLZ

SIGNATURE TEN SLICE COLLECTION

Add a tiny official-style OPLZ logo signature in a restrained position. No Chinese text. No heavy fonts. No crude menu-board styling. All text must remain secondary to the pizza.

Use extremely delicate, soft, world-class studio lighting with refined top-front diffusion and subtle directional shaping. Highlights on cheese, oil, burrata, vegetables, and crust edges must feel luminous but controlled. Shadows should be short, soft, and velvety, adding depth without heaviness. The image should feel bright enough to stimulate appetite, but restrained enough to remain luxurious and official. Every highlight transition must feel smooth, cinematic, and expensive.

Keep the overall palette rich but tightly controlled: roasted golden crust, ivory and cream cheese, deep tomato red, olive green, herb green, caramelized brown, soft truffle beige, dark meat brown, and restrained chili red accents. prompt:
Create an ultra-premium advertising poster for a fictional chocolate sandwich cookie brand called “WHIRLO”, designed as a Cannes-level commercial print ad that combines one hyper-realistic hero cookie with a whimsical vertical tornado of illustrated snack-world energy. The final image must preserve the same iconic composition logic: large title at the top, one oversized central cookie as the visual anchor, and a swirling upward-downward universe of playful doodle objects wrapped around an invisible spiral column. The image should feel joyful, clever, collectible, and product-led, while remaining extremely clean, highly controlled, and internationally polished.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical poster with one giant realistic chocolate sandwich cookie centered in the upper-middle area as the main focal point, enlarged slightly so it dominates the layout more powerfully at first glance. Beneath and around the cookie, build a tall tornado-like spiral made of playful doodle objects, cream swirls, tiny illustrated snack icons, abstract shapes, hands, ribbons, and whimsical everyday fragments, all spiraling around a clear vertical axis. The composition must feel like a controlled vortex of imagination exploding from the cookie’s center. Keep the structure visually strong and iconic, not loose or chaotic.

Brand creation:
Brand name: “WHIRLO”
Main headline: “SPIN INTO JOY”
Support line: “Chocolate Sandwich Cookie”
Optional micro copy:
“Cream at the Core”
“Twist the Ordinary”
“Wonder in Every Bite”
All copy must be original, premium, and beautifully art-directed. Do not copy the sample wording. Typography should feel playful, elegant, and graphic, with a mature international poster hierarchy.

Product realism:
Render the main cookie with extreme photorealistic precision: embossed dark cocoa biscuit texture, crisp edge ridges, creamy white filling layer, realistic crumbs, subtle shadow grounding, and tactile surface relief. Add one or two smaller realistic cookies floating within the swirl for support, but keep the central hero cookie as the strongest anchor. The main cookie should feel slightly more dominant, like the gravity source of the whole poster.

Orbit-style impact:
Increase the first-glance force by enlarging the central cookie slightly and tightening the relationship between the hero cookie and the surrounding cream-and-object tornado. The viewer should first register the cookie, then the spiral energy, then the playful micro-world around it. The cookie must feel like the central engine of the whole composition.

Transit-style system discipline:
Keep the entire poster standardized under one mature visual system. All small doodle objects, cream ribbons, geometric fragments, floating hands, shoes, stars, ladders, books, and mini cookies must follow one coherent outline thickness, one controlled color hierarchy, and one repeatable visual rhythm. The image should feel like part of a polished international snack-brand campaign rather than a random doodle collage.

Illustration tornado:
Build a dense but elegant spiral world of miniature illustrated objects and snack-surreal symbols, such as:
- cream ribbons and splash loops
- candy bits and geometric confetti
- tiny toy-like objects and doodle props
- playful hands, shoes, ladders, books, and sweets
- floating stars, droplets, smiley shapes, and abstract loops
- one or two tiny cookie companions
Everything must feel highly designed, witty, and collectible, not random clutter. The spiral should feel like a fantasy ecosystem born from the cookie’s cream center.

Graphic style:
Use refined contemporary doodle-pop illustration with thin clean outlines, bright candy colors, and smooth graphic filling. The illustrated elements must feel light, playful, and premium. Keep them secondary to the cookie, but rich enough to reward close viewing.

Typography layout:
Place the main title at the top in large bold playful typography. Add one smaller support line beneath it. Optionally place a minimal brand signature or small logo-style mark near the bottom. Keep the poster text sparse and beautifully spaced. Do not add unnecessary copy blocks.

Color direction:
Use a pale warm cream background, deep cocoa brown for the cookie, soft milk-white cream filling, and a bright but tasteful accent palette of pink, sky blue, yellow, mint, orange, and red for the doodle objects. The overall image must feel cheerful, premium, and graphically clean.

Lighting:
Use soft refined studio lighting on the realistic cookie with subtle depth and no harsh glare. The illustrated tornado remains graphic and crisp, but the cookie itself must feel dimensional, tactile, and delicious. The overall poster must feel luminous and polished.

Mood and quality:
premium cookie advertising, enlarged hero sandwich cookie, whimsical doodle tornado, collectible snack poster, playful editorial typography, cream-filled fantasy world, highly systemized commercial illustration, clean high-end advertising image, 8k, world-class visual quality

prompt:

The final campaign must center on one sharply defined product world: a smoked tea ritual collection. The image should feel like a museum-grade archive of modern apothecary objects, combining architectural packaging design, tactile raw ingredients, and formal release-card communication. The result must feel nocturnal, sculptural, rare, editorial, and Cannes-level, with the packaging system as the absolute visual hero.

Core composition:
Use a strict overhead flat-lay composition on a seamless charcoal-to-graphite matte background. Arrange the objects across the full frame in a disciplined archival rhythm, balancing large hero canisters, medium ritual jars, small capsules, ingredient bowls, and a formal release card. The layout should feel precise, intentional, and slightly ceremonial rather than casual. Let one or two tallest canisters function as the visual anchors, while smaller vessels and ingredient clusters orbit around them in a controlled hierarchy. Keep strong spacing, clean negative space, and a premium edge-to-edge composition.

Brand and collection logic:
Design an original identity system for OBSIDIAN ATELIER focused on one coherent line:
“SMOKED TEA RITUAL”
Supporting names on selected containers can include:
“Reserve Blend”
“Noir Infusion”
“Ember Leaf”
“Small Batch”
Keep all branding subtle, elegant, and printed directly on the containers in tiny refined serif or modern Roman typography, paired with a discreet gold emblem. No large external headline floating over the composition; the packaging itself must carry the brand language. The scene should feel like an official product release visual for a single elite collection.

Orbit emphasis:
Push the composition into a stronger “ritual archive” hierarchy. The tallest central canister or pair of canisters should feel like the sacred core of the collection, with surrounding spice bowls, tea pearls, capsules, and vessels arranged almost like a ceremonial classification system. The viewer should feel that every element exists to honor and frame the main objects. The full image must read like an elite sensory archive: ordered, precious, restrained, and obsessively curated.

Transit refinement:
Unify the entire system under one sharper category direction: smoked tea ritual. Remove any sense of mixed-product randomness. Every ingredient and every vessel must support a darker, warmer, more mature tea identity built around smoke, roasted depth, spice, and botanical ritual. The composition should communicate a complete premium line rather than a general lifestyle assortment.

Port refinement:
Add one formal material-and-craft release card in the lower-right or lower-left area. The card should be minimal and luxurious, in dark matte stock or soft mineral paper, carrying a small brand emblem and concise release language such as:
“Reserve Blend”
“Copper-Sealed”
“Small Batch”
The card should feel like an official launch plaque or edition note, reinforcing commercial readiness and poster logic without stealing attention from the objects.

Packaging system:
Design a family of ultra-matte black containers in powder-coated metal, ceramic, or soft-touch rigid canister construction with brushed antique-copper lids and trim rings. Include multiple scales: tall cylindrical tea canisters, squat reserve jars, compact ritual capsules, and low collector vessels. The geometry should remain pure, modern, and architectural, with crisp tolerances, subtle chamfers, soft cylindrical massing, and small gold emblem placement. The system must feel globally brandable, couture-level, and highly tactile.

Ingredient styling:
Arrange a tightly edited selection of dark aromatic ingredients around the packaging: smoked black tea pearls, pepper berries, star anise, clove pods, cacao husk, dried citrus peel, toasted seed clusters, resin-dark spice fragments, and finely sorted tea granules. Place some ingredients in small matte-black bowls and others directly on the surface in controlled linear groupings or archival rows. The ingredient styling must feel precise and elevated, not messy, not rustic-market, not decorative excess.

Ritual object layer:
Include one or two secondary ritual cues only, such as a black ceramic candle with pale wax, a minimalist tasting bowl, or a small incense-like vessel. These should deepen the sensory identity of the brand while remaining clearly subordinate to the packaging and ingredients.

Material realism:
Render everything with extreme realism: ultra-matte black surfaces with soft light absorption, brushed copper lids with restrained warm reflections, gold-foil emblem stamping with micro-texture, ceramic bowls with satin glaze, candle wax with creamy density, and raw botanicals with highly tactile detail. The containers must show crisp edges, believable ambient reflections, physically accurate shadows, and distinct surface separation. Nothing should look plastic or generic.

Lighting:
Use soft high-end studio lighting from upper left with a controlled fill from the opposite side. The light must reveal the geometry of the black vessels and the warm metallic glow of the copper lids without flattening the image. Shadows must remain feathered, elegant, and breathable, never muddy, never crushed. Add a gentle warm highlight roll across selected copper lids and canister shoulders to create luxury depth and reinforce the premium hierarchy.

Color system:
Keep the image highly disciplined within a dark prestige palette: obsidian black, graphite, charcoal, antique copper, muted bronze, soft gold, deep espresso brown, spice umber, and faint ember warmth. Let the ingredients introduce subtle tonal variation through natural toasted browns and smoked amber notes. The overall emotional balance must feel nocturnal, refined, ritualistic, collectible, and expensive.

Advertising finish:
The final image must feel like a world-class luxury launch poster for a smoked tea ritual collection: immaculate top-down composition, clear product hierarchy, archive-like placement logic, exceptional material realism, disciplined dark palette, refined branding, and a formal release-card element that completes the campaign. Машина показана в ракурсе три четверти спереди, направлена вправо, с той же перспективой, что и в оригинальном референсе, но теперь в лёгком контролируемом дрифте. Дрифт передаётся через реалистичное смещение веса, лёгкий подъём кузова, аккуратные клубы дыма от задних колёс и едва заметные изогнутые следы шин позади машины, без искажения геометрии авто.

Фары должны полностью соответствовать стилю из исходного фото, с возможным тёплым свечением противотуманок, если они есть у машины. Все наклейки, эмблемы, номера и тонировка — строго как на оригинале.

Автомобиль дрифтует на глянцевом белом полу, похожем на студию, с мягкими отражениями и реалистичными тенями, плюс лёгкие отражения следов дрифта и направленные смазывания.

Фон — чистый градиент от белого к светло-серому, с огромной полупрозрачной жирной надписью модели автомобиля (автоматически определённой с фото), вертикально занимающей фон.

Сверху: аккуратный брендинг (бренд, определённый по фото машины). Ниже — разреженный стилизованный текст с тем же брендом и моделью.

Под машиной: по центру название модели из фото.

Ещё ниже: короткое описание характера автомобиля (экономичность, стиль, надёжность).

Внизу — аккуратная сетка характеристик. Если реальные характеристики модели известны — использовать точные значения, если нет — сгенерировать заглушки в том же формате (4 колонки: мощность, 0–100 км/ч, максимальная скорость, объём двигателя / тип топлива).
